title: Rooftop ambush in the rain
story: Kaze drops out of the storm onto Lena, twin daggers driving down; she catches both blades on her sword. Across the roof Shiro hurls a lightning spell at the assassin, not seeing Tetsu's spear lunging for his back.
setting: rooftop of a skyscraper at night, heavy rain, neon city lights, wet floor, reflections, storm clouds, lightning
lighting: neon lighting, rim light, backlighting, dramatic lighting
